description: Get members of a Sitecore role.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

identity.description: The identity of the role to get members from (e.g. 'sitecore\Author')

recurse.description: If set to true, gets all members recursively (including members of nested roles)

roleOnly.description: If set to true, only gets role members (excluding users)

userOnly.description: If set to true, only gets user members (excluding roles)

name: security-get-role-member
